title: Payment Scheduling and Channel Terms for Kestrel Auto Finance Contracts
content:
These are the payment terms of Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts by credit tier: the window for the first due date, the daily posting cutoff, the representative-assisted payment fee, the debit card limits and whether a payment may be designated principal-only.

| Tier | First due date: minimum days after contract date | First due date: maximum days after contract date | Posting cutoff (Mountain Time) | Representative phone payment fee (USD) | Maximum single debit card payment (USD) | Maximum debit card payments per calendar month | Principal-only payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 30 | 45 | 17:00 | 5.95 | 2500.00 | 2 | allowed |

The first-due-date window counts calendar days from the contract date. The cutoff is local Mountain Time: a payment made after it posts on the next business day.

## Points of reading

- Every tier shares the same first-due-date window (30 to 45 days), cutoff (17:00), phone payment fee (5.95) and debit card limits (2500.00 per payment, 2 per calendar month).
- The tiers differ only in the principal-only designation, which Tier E does not allow and every other tier allows.
- Hypothetical: a contract dated on the 1st of a 30-day month can take a first due date no earlier than 30 days and no later than 45 days after that date.
